technique_name: Write a recipe for a vegan taco bowl.
description:
Vegan Taco Bowl 
 
Ingredients: 
- 1 cup cooked quinoa 
- 1 can black beans, rinsed
- 1 cup corn kernels
- 1 bell pepper, diced
- 1/2 onion, diced
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 tablespoon chili powder
- 1 teaspoon ground cumin
- 1/4 teaspoon sea salt
- 1/4 teaspoon black pepper
- 1/4 cup olive oil
- Juice of 1/2 lime 
- 2 tablespoons chopped fresh cilantro
- 2 avocados, sliced
- 2 tomatoes, diced
- 1/2 cup salsa
- 1/2 cup vegan cheese, shredded (optional) 

Directions: 
1. Preheat oven to 375°F
